svg.aria-label: The supply's own AC-input report against the PDUs
svg.title: The supply's own AC-input report against the PDUs
svg.desc: A scatter of the supply-reported input power minus the PDU-measured wall power, against wall power, shaded by profile.
svg.text: The supply's own AC-input report against the PDUs
Per minute: the supply's input-power field minus the wall (both cords, floors removed), against the wall
If the supply's field were an input meter, these points would sit on zero
wall power, W (PDU A + B, floors removed)
